Dream Eidolon.name: Dream Eidolon
Dream Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is a thing thought up into reality by slumbering minds. Many Dream eidolons are formed from animated dreams that inhabit the infinite bubbles of the Dreamlands—usually, those shaped into existence by the summoner in their sleep. There are, however, many other cases; hags that dwell on the Ethereal Plane, nightmare creatures of Leng and other horrors are often partnered with dream summoners. Perhaps the most unusual are those summoners that call upon their lucid body, the idealized version of themselves they inhabit when they sleep. Such eidolons are particularly intelligent and capable of truly incredible feats of dream logic.

Tradition occult

Traits dream, eidolon, illusion

Home Plane The Dreamlands, Ethereal Plane, The Plane of Leng

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), limb (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

Dream Creature Str +4, Dex +2, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +1; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Nightmare Creature Str +2, Dex +4, Con +0, Int +1, Wis +0, Cha +2; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Deception, Occultism

Senses darkvision

Language Aklo

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.AGQdm4AsGXkaTzJR]{ephemeral existence}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.woR8Dx2cxQAIE3Vf]{through the veil}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.nTdtI5WYK1wrOeTo]{The Mind Makes it Real}

Mage Eidolon.name: Mage Eidolon
Mage Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is empowered by raw, arcane magic. Their origins are among the broadest of any eidolon; the spirit of a great wizard, trapped within a ring. The phantom of an ancient ancestor with great magic acumen. An archmage from another plane, like a necromancer from the Netherworld or a master scholar from the Elemental Planes. Some archmage eidolons are less humanoid, instead resembling strange arcane creatures or entities formed entirely of raw magic. No matter its source, an archmage eidolon is one which harnesses magic far beyond that of any other eidolon.

Tradition arcane

Traits eidolon, phantom, spirit

Home Plane Any plane, commonly Astral

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks fist (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

Arcane Ascendant Str +0, Dex +3, Con +1 Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +4; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Arcane Etudiant Str +0, Dex +3, Con +1, Int +4, Wis +1, Cha +0; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Arcana, Society

Senses low-light vision

Language One common language

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.RmiKsMvSsCydFpyx]{mystic training}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.T5dZCPGuwYNQByZX]{arcane link}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Yjc6Hqpz3128k0rI]{true archmage}

Unleash Ally Eidolon.name: Unleash Ally Eidolon
Unleash Ally Eidolon.description: You use the power of your ally’s heart to call forth a being to fight alongside them. You choose an ally within 30 feet to gain an eidolon as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.SwzPqEsLzZpNufvm]{Summoner Dedication} archetype feat, with a character level equal to your level for 1 minute. The eidolon appears in a space adjacent to the chosen ally. The eidolon has the initial ability of your eidolon.

Fabricate Artifact.name: Fabricate Artifact
Fabricate Artifact.description:
Calling through time, you summon a powerful artifact and wield it, if only for an instant. This relic is a duplicate, pulled from a singular point in the past, to which it is immediately returned. You must have thoroughly studied the artifact or its powers, usually through researching it during downtime. Your GM is arbiter on what information you can uncover, and may set quests in pursuit of such lore—or say that the artifact wholly resists summoning. Attempt an @Check[type:arcana|dc:@self.level|adjustment:2], @Check[type:nature|dc:@self.level|adjustment:2], @Check[type:occultism|dc:@self.level|adjustment:2] or @Check[type:religion|dc:@self.level|adjustment:2] check against the hard DC for your level.

Critical Success You summon an artifact of a level that must be equal or lower than 4 + your level. You cannot attempt to Summon Artifact for 1 day.

Success As a critical success, but the artifact's level must be equal or lower than 2 + your level. You cannot attempt to Summon Artifact for 1 week.

Failure You fail to summon the artifact.

Critical Failure As a failure, but you attract the attention of the artifact's keeper in the process. The keeper or artifact, depending on its nature, may take issue with your actions and gains a clear vision of you attempting to summon it and your current location.

Fabricate Weapon.name: Fabricate Weapon
Fabricate Weapon.description:
With a flourish, you pull a weapon from between planes to attack. Make either a melee @Check[type:spell|defense:ac]{spell attack roll} that deals @Damage[2d10[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]] damage or a ranged spell attack roll with a range of 30 feet that deals @Damage[2d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]] damage. This damage can be bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, your choice at the time you use Summon Weapon. On a critical success, you deal double damage and the target takes an additional @Damage[2d4[persistent,@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage2]]{2d4 persistent} acid, cold, electric, fire, or sonic persistent damage, your choice at the time you use Summon Weapon. On subsequent turns, you make this spell attack when you Sustain your Fabricate Weapon.

If you are at least 10th level the initial damage increases to @Damage[3d10[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]] and @Damage[3d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]] respectively with @Damage[3d4[persistent,@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage2]]{3d4 persistent} persistent damage on a critical, and if you are at least 18th level the initial damage increases to @Damage[4d10[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]] and @Damage[4d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]] respectively with @Damage[4d4[persistent,@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage2]]{4d4 persistent} persistent damage on a critical.

  • @Check[type:spell|defense:ac|traits:summoner,fabrication,attack,damaging-effect,range-30]{Spell Attack Roll}
  • Melee @Damage[(2 + floor(@actor.level/10) + floor(@actor.level/18) floor(@actor.level / 20))d10[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]]
  • Ranged @Damage[(2 + floor(@actor.level/10) + floor(@actor.level/18) floor(@actor.level / 20))d6[@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage1]]
  • Critical Hit @Damage[(2 + floor(@actor.level/10) + floor(@actor.level/18) floor(@actor.level / 20))d4[persistent,@actor.flags.pf2e.fabricate-weapon.damage2]]

Legendary Soul.name: Legendary Soul
Legendary Soul.description:
The force of your eidolon's soul is truly overwhelming. When your eidolon would unmanifest as a result of you being reduced to 0 Hit Points, it can use a reaction to deal @Damage[(@actor.level)d8[spirit]]{1d8 damage per level you possess} to the creature that dealt the final blow before it unmanifests with a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)|basic:true] against your spell DC. When it uses this reaction, your eidolon cannot be manifested again for 10 minutes.

Once per day, your eidolon can spend a single action with the concentrate and eidolon trait to gain fast healing equal to half your level for 1 minute. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points while this effect is active, the effect immediately ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.bDdj5JXLVmfs3zDD]{Effect: Legendary Soul}

Aberration Eidolon.name: Aberration Eidolon
Aberration Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is an abomination of indiscernible or bizarre motivations, stemming from the ranks of the unspeakable, the unseen, and the otherworldly. Aberrative eidolons rarely conform to one shape, often possessing characteristics unique to their specific nature, or rather, their unnature. The two of you are intertwined mentally, emotionally, and spiritually, though each of your thoughts may differ greatly and your missions might be at odds considering your rather estranged statuses of life.

Tradition occult

Traits aberration, eidolon

Home Plane The Netherworld, The Universe

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks claw (piercing), jaws (piercing), tentacle (bludgeoning)

Angelic Avenger Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +0; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Angelic Emissary Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +2; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Occultism, one skill determined by your eidolon’s Unnatural Physiology

Senses darkvision

Language Aklo

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.coFrRiztDPcMRkyp]{unnatural physiology}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.8BiLgJobTff2ftI4]{unspeakable demonstration}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Tzx5Kig7J0i5bsGE]{extraneous anatomy}

Ranged Primary Attack.name: Ranged Primary Attack
Ranged Primary Attack.description:
Your eidolon’s primary unarmed attack is a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 damage and has the propulsive trait and it deals damage of one of the following types: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, vitality, or void.

Special If you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.oVSlTmdmho8ZQo2k]{Ranged Combatant} class feat, you instead gain a melee primary attack appropriate for your eidolon instead of the ranged unarmed attack granted by the feat. If you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.kFpVgcqREAfDmjXp]{Advanced Weaponry} class feat, your eidolon’s ranged unarmed attack gains the versatile trait with another damage type you could have selected at 1st level.

Extra Head.name: Extra Head
Extra Head.description:
Your eidolon grows an additional head. Your eidolon gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and it can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Point Out} as a reaction whenever it successfully detects a creature. Your eidolon gains an additional reaction that it can only use to Point Out each turn.

Any ability that would sever your eidolon’s head (such as the vorpal weapon property) doesn’t cause you to be reduced to 0 Hit Points if it still has a head, but does cause it to lose its additional reaction. Your eidolon can regrow a head in 1 week.

Change Shape.name: Change Shape
Change Shape.description: Your eidolon has mastered the ability to hide among mortals. It changes into a specific humanoid of its choice, usually reminiscent of its eidolon appearance. This shape has a specific, persistent appearance, and its @Check[type:deception|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value + 5)] against attempts to discover it is disguised is 15 + your spell proficiency modifier instead of the normal DC to detect that it is not in its true form (though it does not learn its true form). This doesn’t change its Speed or its attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes, but it does change the damage type of its unarmed attacks to another damage type it would have access to. This shape suppresses your summoner’s symbol on both you and your eidolon, but you must still remain within range of your eidolon.

Rider Manifestation.name: Rider Manifestation
Rider Manifestation.description:
Your eidolon is bound to you for a specific purpose, to give you the ability to move as it moves, serving as a mount. You can ride your eidolon and while you ride it, you get your full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride your eidolon, not when anyone else does. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.dpYPlCJdKzHhB1Hs]{Manifest Mount Eidolon} activity instead of the Manifest Eidolon activity. You can ride your eidolon even if it is your size, ignoring the requirement that it must be at least one size category larger than you to ride it, as it gains accompanying magical remnants that allow it to carry you. Your eidolon cannot use actions for the turn unless you are riding your eidolon, you are using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3ZzoI9MTtJFd1Kjl]{Share Senses}, or unless the actions are move actions towards you so that you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} your eidolon again. Since you and your eidolon are built to work as one unit, your eidolon’s move actions while you are riding it do not gain the tandem trait. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.dJCr7YPXuBTLnOUe]{Tandem Mount} action.

If you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.eCzIiTjI4mQFYe9D]{Steed Form} summoner feat, when you Manifest Mount Eidolon you instead merge with your eidolon entirely while you are mounted and you cannot be dismounted unless you use Manifest Mount Eidolon again. While manifested in this way, you can target your eidolon instead of yourself when you use spells that would normally only affect you, such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} cantrip.

In exploration mode, you can perform two exploration activities as normal for a summoner that has their eidolon manifested and is using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2KV87ponbWXgGIhZ]{Act Together}, but your exploration activities must be possible while mounted for both you and your eidolon (subject to GM discretion).

Additional Appendage.name: Additional Appendage
Additional Appendage.description: Your eidolon has grown a set of extra arms. Your eidolon can perform simple Interact actions with this appendage such as opening an unlocked door or picking up objects. In addition, your eidolon gains another primary melee unarmed attack which your eidolon would normally be able to select at 1st level. Your eidolon gains an additional reaction that it can only use to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} each turn.

Mighty Brain.name: Mighty Brain
Mighty Brain.description:
Your eidolon is gifted with an extraordinary brain. It gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.kdhbPaBMK1d1fpbA]{Telepathy} (120 feet), and can translate other languages it hears into the minds of creatures it chooses.

Once per day, your eidolon can spend a single action with the concentrate and eidolon trait to connect its mind to another creature within range of its telepathy, and the creature must attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] against your spell DC. Creatures that fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{confused} for 1 round, or for 1 minute on a critical failure.

Spirit Synchronicity.name: Spirit Synchronicity
Spirit Synchronicity.description: You and your eidolon’s attacks are infused with energy that manipulates life. When you use Tandem Boost’s @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.VucxKRn4BC9O3gCf]{synergy combo}, you can change the additional damage from precision damage to vitality or void damage and the Strike gains the listed trait. In addition, when you critically succeed at a Strike while you have synergy, the target of your Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} for 1 round. This enfeebled condition lasts for 2 rounds at 10th level, and for 3 rounds at 18th level.

Kindred Warriors.name: Kindred Warriors
Kindred Warriors.description:
You have been bound to an eidolon through sheer will and physical perfection, your magical energies focused on your abilities to fight as one unit among two bodies. You must select @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.vrfLOHVVixrY5TwJ]{Kindred Warrior Dedication} as your 2nd-level class feat.

Prerequisites: You must be a summoner.

Key Attribute: Your key attribute is Dexterity or Strength instead of Charisma. Your spell attack modifier and spell DC use your Charisma modifier.

Kindred Warrior Adjustments: You do not gain summoner spellcasting, a spell repertoire, or unlimited signature spells. You still gain the Cast a Spell activity and Link Spells, including @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon} and your spellcasting attribute is Charisma.

Special If you select the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.b1eGMNjBY3iqIt2S]{Magical Adept} class feat, your eidolon can select spells that are 2 or more levels lower than your highest rank spell you can cast.

When you gain a class feature that would improve your eidolon’s unarmed attacks, you also gain the same benefits with martial weapons, simple weapons, and unarmed attacks, including increases to damage, such as the eidolon weapon specialization class feature.

You are trained in medium and light armor in addition to unarmored defense, and when you would increase your proficiency in unarmored defense, you also increase your proficiency in medium and light armor. You gain the Defensive Robes class feature at 11th level instead of 13th level, and you become a master in unarmored defense at 19th level. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.0PBsvIdslXmuei5s]{Tandem Boost} action, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.eCBKJ4SEwF7Hiuvb]{Synergy} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.VucxKRn4BC9O3gCf]{Synergy Combos} class features.

Shell Armor.name: Shell Armor
Shell Armor.description: Your eidolon grows natural armor, like hardened stone or thick chitin. This changes your eidolon’s unarmored state to be treated as if it were armor in the plate armor group with a +4 item bonus to AC, a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, and a Strength value of +3. In addition, your eidolon gains a +1 circumstance bonus against Reflex saves to avoid damaging effect.

We Feed on Fear.name: We Feed on Fear
We Feed on Fear.description: You and your eidolon have become synergized when an enemy fears you. If you or your eidolon cause a creature to become frightened, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.H0W9EDjO1wwp38ty]{Synergy}.

Quick Miniaturize.name: Quick Miniaturize
Quick Miniaturize.description: Your eidolon can shrink at a moment’s notice. At the beginning of your turn, your eidolon can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.ZGJhdhEWlxnu4W5B]{Shrink Down} as a free action.

Fabricate Tool.name: Fabricate Tool
Fabricate Tool.description:
You conjure a tool necessary for a job. Choose a common item of level 1 or lower that is used to perform a skill action, bringing it into existence within your space or an adjacent space. If the space you summon the tool in is occupied by an ally and that ally has sufficient hands, they can be holding or wielding the item. If the space is occupied by you, you can be wielding or holding the item and can perform a single action with the tool as part of Fabricate Tool or when you Sustain. The tool can only be used to perform skill checks, and the fabrication dissipates if it is used for any other task.

If you are 7th level or higher, you gain a +1 item bonus to checks with the item you summoned.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.10wsEzk2WHoU8ndk]

Forever in Tandem.name: Forever in Tandem
Forever in Tandem.description: You gain the ability to perform actions at blinding speed when you act with your eidolon. Choose an action with the tandem trait that takes a single action to perform. You can use the chosen action as you or your eidolon’s single action when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2KV87ponbWXgGIhZ]{Act Together}, ignoring the normal requirement that actions you use must not contain the tandem trait.

Opportunity Duplicity.name: Opportunity Duplicity
Opportunity Duplicity.description: Your eidolon has adapted the ability to perform other reactive activities. Your eidolon can spend its additional reaction it gained from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.AgwucsLTEIT2HuCP]{Additional Appendage} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.7vE2F7itS6coHQS6]{Extra Head} to use its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.588O3jurogttvqgm]{Eidolon's Opportunity} instead of its additional reaction. Your eidolon cannot gain more than 1 additional reaction for Eidolon’s Opportunity.

Devil (Demon) Eidolon.name: Devil (Demon) Eidolon
Devil (Demon) Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is not a demon of the Outer Rifts, glutted on selfish and hateful desires; rather, it is a wicked architect of the legions of Hell.

Your eidolon is a demon, born of mortal sin congealed amid the chaos and evil of the Abyss, using its link to you to spread chaos at your side. Choose an associated sin for your demon. Demon eidolons have appearances as varied as the infinite Abyss. While demons are inherently untrustworthy, your demon eidolon has reached an accord with you and generally keeps it, though that doesn't mean your eidolon isn't actively working to bring your life deeper into its associated sin. Though a true demon, your demon eidolon's link to you as a mortal prevents them from casting the abyssal pact ritual, even if they somehow learn it.

Tradition divine

Traits demon, eidolon, fiend

Alignment must be chaotic evil

Home Plane Hell

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), horn (piercing), tail (bludgeoning), tentacle (bludgeoning), wing (bludgeoning)

Wrecker Demon Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 8, Cha 12; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Tempter Demon Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 16; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Deception, Religion

Senses darkvision

Language Diabolic

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.o3P8heIfNr1z53Ay]{demonic strikes}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.Hh72IZK36NLATQWF]{punishing contract}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.C0zzz9wVwfmGtfIQ]{blasphemous decree}

Splintered Manifestation.name: Splintered Manifestation
Splintered Manifestation.description:
Your eidolon is a collection of creatures instead of a single creature, each bound to you much the same way a single eidolon would be. Each of your splintered eidolons functions as a single creature for the purposes of spells and effects, and each eidolon uses the same single pool of Hit Points as a normal eidolon. Each round, you can use any of your actions (including reactions and free actions) for yourself or each of your eidolons. Your eidolons can only spend a number of actions equal to the number of eidolons you have manifested, though these actions can be spent by any of your currently manifested eidolons. For instance, if you have only 2 of your splintered eidolons manifested, your eidolons can spend 2 actions for the turn, either 1 action each or 2 actions by one of your eidolons. If an area of effect would include multiple eidolons and yourself, you use the worst result among you and the eidolon with the lowest modifier for determining the results, including any effects that would reduce this result (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.knJlRpltciLNTZba]{Protective Bond}).

Choose one type of eidolon, and create three different eidolons with that eidolon type. Whenever you would make a choice as part of the eidolon's progression, such as for its eidolon array, you make the choice separately for each eidolon. When you choose these eidolons, you also determine their appearance and general form for each individually as if they were separate eidolons. When you gain evolution feats, you can choose two evolution feats that you could qualify for, applying each to one of your three different eidolons. Your eidolons can never have more than 1 evolution feat than another one of your eidolons, as their form becomes unable to sustain too many evolutions compared to their splintered counterparts. If your eidolon has an ability with a frequency or cost, each of your eidolons are subject to the frequency and costs when any of your splintered eidolons uses the ability (such as dragon eidolon’s Breath Weapon). If your eidolons have an ability with an aura, a creature can only be affected by an eidolon’s aura once per turn.

If an ability would use an eidolon’s location for its effect, you choose one of your eidolon’s locations to determine the effects. If an eidolon would gain an ability that grants skill evolutions, feats, Focus Points, or skill training, such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.AaVyAec0r17ocz42]{Reconfigured Evolution} for a construct eidolon, you only gain the effect once and you choose which of your splintered eidolons gains the benefit when you first gain the ability.

If you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.E5ewlRE6Mh9ZqUMu]{Ostentatious Arrival} class feat, you gain its effect when you use Manifest Splintered Eidolon to manifest a third eidolon instead of when you Manifest Eidolon as a 3-action activity. At 19th level, when you would gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.H0iWhiyP0QqgmAKs]{Instant Manifestation} summoner class feature, you can manifest all 3 of your splintered eidolons when you use Manifest Splintered Eidolon.

You bring your eidolon into reality with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.nS8E2BNuiXTVzbY9]{Manifest Splintered Eidolon} action. You and each of your eidolons share actions and multiple attack penalty. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2KV87ponbWXgGIhZ]{Act Together}, you can select one of your eidolons to coordinate with yourself, or you can select two of your eidolons to coordinate instead, following all the requirements for the Act Together action as normal. Your eidolons gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.ENFrVTSjEnLVBTXo]{Coordinated Stride} action and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.jemFBuSq3gSWKIQ1]{Coordinated Assault} activity.

Fabricate Rift.name: Fabricate Rift
Fabricate Rift.description:
You call forth a rift through space. You create a portal adjacent to your current space and a portal within 30 feet of you that you have line of effect and line of sight. You can Stride through this portal as part of the activity to create it. Any creature can use the portal by moving through its space, treating both ends of the portal as adjacent squares for the purposes of this movement. Move actions that would cause you to enter the portal gain the teleportation trait. If a creature is subject to forced movement from another creature that would cause the creature to enter the square of the portal, the creature that initiated the forced movement can decide whether the portal is used for the purposes of this movement. The portal can only transport a single creature per round, and subsequent attempts to move through the portal on the same round automatically fail.

@Template[type:square|distance:5]{Portal Template}

Dual Studies+.name: Dual Studies+
Dual Studies+.description: You and your eidolon have some skills you practice on your own. Choose two skills. You become trained in those skills. If you were already trained in a skill, you become trained in another skill of your choice. At 7th level, you each become an expert in one of the chosen skills, or if you were already expert in both skills, you become expert in another skill in which you are trained.

Drastic Evolution.name: Drastic Evolution
Drastic Evolution.description:
Your summoning powers explode out, changing your eidolon into something new. When you take this feat, select a creature trait that corresponds to your eidolon. You Summon a common creature that has that trait and a level no greater than your level – 4 and it gains 2 actions for the turn when you use this activity. This creature appears in the same space as your eidolon, which disappears for the duration of this effect. You can Sustain this effect for up to 1 minute. The Summoned Creature’s mind is that of your eidolon, though it can’t use any abilities with the eidolon trait, it can still be targeted with effects that would normally target an eidolon (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{Boost Eidolon}). When the effect ends, your eidolon reappears in the summoned creature’s space.

Special This action has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).

Kindred in Range.name: Kindred in Range
Kindred in Range.description: You and your eidolon coordinate with ranged attacks. While you have synergy, enemies either of you have in melee reach are off-guard to either of your ranged Strikes within their first range increment.

Controlled Wrath.name: Controlled Wrath
Controlled Wrath.description: Your eidolon has learned to channel its wrath more profoundly. If the next action your eidolon uses is to Cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kuZnUNrhXHRYQ2eM]{eidolon's wrath}, it can alter the area to be a @Template[distance:30|type:cone], a @Template[distance:60|type:line], or a @Template[distance:10|type:burst] within 30 feet.

Cryptic Coloration.name: Cryptic Coloration
Cryptic Coloration.description: Your eidolon can camouflage itself exceptionally well, the texture and color of its hide warping to match its surroundings. Your eidolon creates a self surrounded camouflage, granting it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{concealment} until the beginning of its next turn. This concealment lasts until your eidolon uses an action other than @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Step} or until it enters an area that does not match its current surroundings (subject to GM discretion).

Oni Eidolon.name: Oni Eidolon
Oni Eidolon.description:
You have made a connection to an oni, one of the vicious guardians of nature of Tian Xia. Formerly a kami, your eidolon was corrupted into its current form by some great disaster that damaged its very core. Now, it is bound to you, to be brought redemption by your actions… or to be corrupted by your villainy.

Tradition primal

Traits eidolon, giant, oni

Home Plane The Universe

Size Medium (see Rampaging Spirit)

Suggested Attacks tetsubo (bludgeoning), other unarmed attack resembling a weapon (bludgeoning, slashing, piercing)

Accursed Oni Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +3; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Rampaging Oni Str +4, Dex +1, Con +3, Int –1, Wis +0, Cha +2; +3 AC (+2 Dex cap)

Skills Athletics, Nature

Senses low-light vision

Language Tien

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.UgC7EEaeRZg4eoYp]{rampaging spirit}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.vwKyqC54slJGsXDx]{infinite power cascade}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.f77t4YLJkaKWVLuJ]{final form}

Staff of The Eidolon Binder.name: Staff of The Eidolon Binder
Staff of The Eidolon Binder.description:
This black staff has white wrappings around its side, marked with otherworldly words of power. It terminates in a large gemstone, which appears to contain entire worlds within it. While wielding a staff of the eidolon binder, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3ZzoI9MTtJFd1Kjl]{Share Senses} as a free action, so long as it is the first action you take for the turn.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.AfOpnnwdZwHi2Tnc]{Protect Companion}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.cwXiKPkZrIupjwlQ]{Summoner's Precaution}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vb2dFNtbofJ7A9BW]{Summoner's Visage}
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.gWmLT5SkA0qH2mNE]{Envenom Companion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HIY4XUJZKmFLAJTn]{Life Connection}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.

Staff of The Eidolon Binder (Major).name: Staff of The Eidolon Binder (Major)
Staff of The Eidolon Binder (Major).description:
This black staff has white wrappings around its side, marked with otherworldly words of power. It terminates in a large gemstone, which appears to contain entire worlds within it. While wielding a staff of the eidolon binder, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3ZzoI9MTtJFd1Kjl]{Share Senses} as a free action, so long as it is the first action you take for the turn.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.AfOpnnwdZwHi2Tnc]{Protect Companion}
