  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.cwXiKPkZrIupjwlQ]{Summoner's Precaution}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vb2dFNtbofJ7A9BW]{Summoner's Visage}
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.gWmLT5SkA0qH2mNE]{Envenom Companion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HIY4XUJZKmFLAJTn]{Life Connection}
  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HqTI6wRrck1YXp3F]{Telepathy}
  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{Sending}
  • 6th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}
  • 7th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HES5jvGiNZZnJycK]{Force Cage}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.2Vkd1IxylPceUAAF]{Regenerate}
  • 8th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wfleiawxsfhpRRwf]{Disappearance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4MOew29Z1oCX8O28]{Moment of Renewal}
  • 9th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.

Fabricate Demiplane.name: Fabricate Demiplane
Fabricate Demiplane.description:
You can call forth fractions of other worlds rather than entities. You fill a @Template[distance:20|type:burst] within 30 feet with the properties of a demiplane. You make one demiplane with a planar essence trait listed below, gaining the effect of the associated trait. If your casting tradition is divine or occult, you can select the fire, shadow, void, or vitality traits and if your casting tradition is arcane or primal, you can select any of the elemental traits.

Air: All creatures in the area gain a +20-foot status bonus to their Speed and this status bonus to Speed also increases the distances a creature can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} by the same amount. Creatures in the area do not need to Stride at least 10 feet to High Jump or Long Jump and creatures in the area that would be affected by forced movement move 10 feet further than they normally would in the same direction.

Earth: The area becomes difficult terrain. Creatures that begin their turn in the area must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save or they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{immobilized} until the end of their next turn.

Fire: The area is of intense heat, causing flammable objects to burst into flame at the beginning of each turn they remain in the area. Creatures in the area take @Damage[max(1, floor(@actor.level/2))d4[fire]]{1d4 fire damage per two levels you possess} damage at the beginning of each turn they remain in the area with a basic @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)|basic:true] save.

Metal: The area is hazardous terrain that deals @Damage[@actor.level[slashing]]{slashing damage equal to your level} each time creatures move through a square in the area. 

Shadow: The area reduces bright light to dim light in the area, dim light to darkness, and darkness to greater darkness. Effects with the light trait of a rank lower than half your level rounded up are automatically extinguished.

Void: Living creatures in the area take @Damage[max(1, floor(@actor.level/2))d4[void]]{1d4 void damage per two levels you possess} you possess at the beginning of each turn they remain in the area with a basic @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)|basic:true] save. Undead creatures in the area restore @Damage[max(1, floor(@actor.level/2))d4[void,healing]]{1d4 Hit Points per two levels you possess} at the beginning of each turn they remain in the area.

Vitality: Undead creatures in the area take @Damage[max(1, floor(@actor.level/2))d4[vitality]]{1d4 vitality damage per two levels you possess} at the beginning of each turn they remain in the area with a basic Fortitude save. Living creatures in the area restore @Damage[max(1, floor(@actor.level/2))d4[vitality,healing]]{1d4 Hit Points per two levels you possess} at the beginning of each turn they remain in the area.

Water: The area is aquatic and creatures in the area are unable to cast fire spells or use actions with the fire trait and must hold their breath if they cannot breath in water. Creatures that begin their turn in the area must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save, moving 5 feet in a direction of your choice on failure or 10 feet on a critical failure.

Wood: The area contains up to 4 structures of your choice made of wood. These structures occupy an area up to a 10-foot cube and can be combined to perform a singular structure, such as a bridge or wall. These structures can extend outside the area of the initial burst, but they must form a contiguous shape to a square within the burst. These structures provide greater cover and each 10-foot cube has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 20 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage.

Tandem Ready.name: Tandem Ready
Tandem Ready.description: You and your eidolon prepare to take an action in unison. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.dLgAMt3TbkmLkUqE]{Ready} with the same conditions, except you designate a single action or free action for both yourself and your eidolon to use at the time of the trigger and you both act in unison when the trigger is met. You can select different actions for yourself and your eidolon, and you must select the order of these actions when you use Tandem Ready. If the action you and your eidolon readied would apply a multiple attack penalty, you do not increase your multiple attack penalty until both your actions are completed.

Unseemly (Beast) Eidolon.name: Unseemly (Beast) Eidolon
Unseemly (Beast) Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon’s body and biology are anomalous to traditional beasts, possibly having many appendages, unusual anatomy, and the ability to produce unseemly excretions.

Your eidolon is a manifestation of the life force of nature in the form of a powerful magical beast that often has animal features, possibly even several from different species. You might have learned the way to connect with the world's life force via a specific philosophy or practice, such as the beliefs of the god callers of Sarkoris, or formed a bond on your own. Regardless, your link to your eidolon allows you both to grow in power and influence to keep your home safe from those who would despoil it.

Tradition primal

Traits beast, eidolon

Home Plane Material Plane

Size Medium

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), fangs (piercing), hoof (bludgeoning), horn (piercing)

Brutal Beast Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Fleet Beast Str 14, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Acrobatics, Nature

Senses low-light vision

Language Sylvan

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.lonj7zEZdJD2pbai]{beast's charge}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.YJuyhql7BgTmXMoN]{inhibiting excretion}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.coBen1GA1czeBTOs]{whirlwind maul}

Fungus (Plant) Eidolon.name: Fungus (Plant) Eidolon
Fungus (Plant) Eidolon.description:
While plants feed themselves through the power of sunlight, fungus is empowered by the rotting power of death. Your eidolon is an entity of decay, a crucial part of the cycle of life.

Your eidolon is an intelligent plant, formed from the same disembodied fragments of nature's life energy that become leshys. Plant eidolons tend to be curious and adaptable, with temperaments based on the parts of mortal culture they feel affinity toward. Despite coming from the same source, plant eidolons don't always look like leshys. Plant eidolons have forms that vary greatly and can look like almost any kind of plant creature in existence. Some even resemble plant creatures so strange they are impossible to identify.

Tradition primal

Traits eidolon, plant

Home Plane Material Plane

Size Medium

Suggested Attacks vine (bludgeoning), branch (bludgeoning), root (bludgeoning)

Guardian Plant Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Creeping Plant Str 12, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 14, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Nature, Stealth

Senses low-light vision

Language Sylvan

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.zE41sGx7afQPw97M]{spore cloud}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.wbM1KHZr45mn8o8a]{spore plume}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.kpcL3Iz1KJnmEKwC]{field of roots}

Life Eidolon.name: Life Eidolon
Life Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is a creature empowered by overwhelming life energy. It might resemble a phoenix or an ouroboros, a being of Creation’s Forge like a gliminal, or even certain fey creatures like hora queens. No matter the appearance your eidolon takes, life surges from it at all times, imbuing those around it with vitality.

Tradition primal

Traits eidolon, vitality

Home Plane Astral Plane, Creation’s Forge, First World

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws or beak (piercing), fist or wing (bludgeoning)

Vital Juggernaut Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int –1, Wis +1, Cha +0, +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Vital Messenger Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +2, +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Medicine, Nature

Senses darkvision

Language Jyoti

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.6b58rcxzSCpM2BbB]{pure life force}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.LVT1aZKpSBRkbCUd]{overflowing vigor}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.BwfIMZ7fGH3d9VFt]{vitality springs forth}

Shuffle Card.name: Shuffle Card
Shuffle Card.description: This pair of magnetic tile fragments are embedded into matching anklets that gently twitch towards and then past each other when left unattended. While worn by a summoner and their eidolon, both gain a +10-foot status bonus to their Speed when moving towards one another. If your eidolon has the Alacritous Action evolution feat, this status bonus increases to a +20-foot status bonus under these circumstances. This status bonus applies to Climb, Fly, and Swim speeds in addition to yours and your eidolon’s Speed.

Mighty Summons.name: Mighty Summons
Mighty Summons.description:
Your experience with your eidolon has made you a master at summoning other creatures. If your next action is to cast a summon spell from your summoner spell slots, you can summon creatures as if the spell you cast were 1 rank higher. If you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2KV87ponbWXgGIhZ]{Act Together} to Cast a Spell with the summon trait, this spellshape applies to the spell you cast so long as it was the immediate preceding action to your Act Together.

Special If this would summon creatures of a rank higher than a rank 10 spell, such as if you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.wPjNjyh60fYKrDXl]{Legendary Summoner}, it instead summons a creature two levels higher than the level specified.

Incarnate Manifestation.name: Incarnate Manifestation
Incarnate Manifestation.description:
Your eidolon is an incarnate of a powerful being that can only remain manifested for short periods of time. You do not gain Manifest Eidolon, since your eidolon is impermanent. Instead, because your eidolon is bound within you, it is released from your sigil when you use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.0kiDkpkmr4ABMGZz]{Manifest Incarnate Eidolon} activity. Your eidolon cannot remain manifested unless you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain} its presence, being too powerful to manifest for greater time periods. Your eidolon can remain manifested from your Sustain for up to 1 minute before it automatically unmanifests and can’t be manifested again for at least 1 minute. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.tIkttSpMKNdtuRtP]{Call the Incarnate} tandem action and your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.0fvd9aASh27TJYOj]{Incarnate Arrival} activity and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.LKTHOzyQjzuxDG66]{Power of the Incarnate} action.

While unmanifested, your eidolon can still communicate with you telepathically. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.CXW8SdSskWNohW8w]{Project Senses} action, which allows your eidolon to grant you its senses while unmanifested. While in exploration mode, since you cannot manifest your eidolon for extended periods, you cannot take more than one exploration activity, but you can use any exploration activities your eidolon could perform in addition to your own by using your ability to Project Senses.

Shrink Down+.name: Shrink Down+
Shrink Down+.description: Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces. Your eidolon reduces in size, to a minimum of size Tiny. It can use this action again while shrunk to return to its normal size.

Legend Eidolon.name: Legend Eidolon
Legend Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is an extraplanar warrior of great power, given form by or empowered by arcane magic. Their origin might be a hero of generations past like a great ancestor or a mighty einherjar; they may also be the astral projection of a creature like a boar-headed ax master, a weapon wielding griffonid, a four-armed cyclops berserker or some other bizarre martial monster from the depths of imagination.

Tradition arcane

Traits eidolon, phantom, spirit

Home Plane Any plane, commonly Astral

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks fist (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

Warrior Brute Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +1; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Warrior Skirmisher Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +2; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Arcana, Athletics

Senses darkvision

Language One common language

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.BPn644yIO8XN3MGs]{heart of a warrior}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.ZVZrbFQCJZmzpF8t]{glory seeker}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.09GqtLpix3Tiv60D]{victory's companion}

Protean Eidolon.name: Protean Eidolon
Protean Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is a writhing embodiment of elemental chaos and instability. As an avatar of the randomness and fickle nature of the universe, it is a difficult beast to tame— equal parts inscrutable, unpredictable and uncannily wily. Though they generally follow the orders of their summoners, protean eidolons have a reputation for having an agenda of their own— one which certain masters find themselves unknowing pawns to.

Tradition divine

Traits eidolon, monitor, protean

Home Plane Maelstorm

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks jaws (piercing), claws (slashing), tail (bludgeoning)

Protean Riddler Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +3; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Protean Unraveler Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +1; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Skills Deception, Religion

Senses darkvision, entropy sense (imprecise) 15 feet

Language Protean

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.sx6MgQz2v05Jtk0M]{entropic entity}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.FAO2gAErpSxkn4RB]{warpwave strike}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.9PDz7tZtDgOEWT5F]{disrupt reality}

Strike Barrage.name: Strike Barrage
Strike Barrage.description:
Requirements You are adjacent to your eidolon and have synergy.

With a mighty cry, you and your eidolon unleash a flurry of punches, kicks or weapon attacks into your opponent that are impossible to dodge. Creatures in the area must make a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)|basic:true] against your spell DC. The number of actions you spend when using this action determines the area and other parameters.

2 The area is a @Template[type:cone|distance:10] or a @Template[type:line|distance:20]; creatures take damage equal to two of your eidolon’s Strikes. On a critical failure, creatures are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}.

3 As with 2-action, but the area is a @Template[type:cone|distance:20] or a @Template[type:line|distance:40]. If only a single creature would be affected by this effect, increase the damage to three Strikes.

Synergy Combo You can choose to double the area of the @Template[type:cone|distance:40]{cone} or a @Template[type:line|distance:80]{line} and you increase the damage to a single creature by two additional Strikes if you used the 3-action activity.

Airborne (Beast) Eidolon.name: Airborne (Beast) Eidolon
Airborne (Beast) Eidolon.description:
Not all beasts are ones confined to the earth such as ourselves. Certain eidolons take to the sky, hunting from above on magnificent wings.

Your eidolon is a manifestation of the life force of nature in the form of a powerful magical beast that often has animal features, possibly even several from different species. You might have learned the way to connect with the world's life force via a specific philosophy or practice, such as the beliefs of the god callers of Sarkoris, or formed a bond on your own. Regardless, your link to your eidolon allows you both to grow in power and influence to keep your home safe from those who would despoil it.

Tradition primal

Traits beast, eidolon

Home Plane Material Plane

Size Medium

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), fangs (piercing), hoof (bludgeoning), horn (piercing)

Brutal Beast Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Fleet Beast Str 14, Dex 18, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Acrobatics, Nature

Senses low-light vision

Language Sylvan

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.8HdHYssXliHclIT6]{flying beast}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Gn750G9nNM3GiI5k]{primal roar}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.PV9OjHFK4tjR6sNh]{whirlwind wings}

Paired Performers.name: Paired Performers
Paired Performers.description: You and your eidolon perform together well. You and your eidolon gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.7LB00jkh6JaJr3vS]{Fascinating Performance} skill feat. You can choose to give your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} the tandem trait, allowing you and your eidolon to Perform as a single action. In addition, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.H0W9EDjO1wwp38ty]{Synergy} during an encounter when the result of your or your eidolon’s Performance check to Perform exceeds the Will DC of an observing foe, even if the foe isn't fascinated.

Eager Synergy.name: Eager Synergy
Eager Synergy.description:
Trigger You roll for initiative.

You and your eidolon have become attuned to entering battles. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.H0W9EDjO1wwp38ty]{Effect: Synergy}.

Ooze Eidolon.name: Ooze Eidolon
Ooze Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is an unusual specimen, created from the dredges of ethereal remains on transitional planes. Rather than a fully formed being like most eidolons, it is a blob, a single cell organism made of the remains of magic, congealed into an entity that you have managed to control. Some summoners see ooze eidolons as the mark of a failed or unintentional summoner; others know that these strange beings hide peculiar potential.

Tradition occult

Traits eidolon, ooze

Home Plane Astral Plane, Ethereal Plane, First World, Netherworld

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks pseudopod (piercing), slam (bludgeoning), tendril (slashing)

Angelic Avenger Str +4, Dex +2, Con +3, Int -1, Wis +1, Cha +0; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Angelic Emissary Str +2, Dex +4, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +0; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Acrobatics, Occultism

Senses motion sense (imprecise) 30 feet

Language Aklo

Speed 15 feet, climb 15 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.MysPtXRn4Y26cmwh]{ooze biology}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.7mHYbcgvRVykN0su]{gelatinous expansion}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.QVxp8UefAgWx4axa]{engulfing propensity}

Eidolon Egg.name: Eidolon Egg
Eidolon Egg.description:
This peculiar egg appears mundane until it is seen by a summoner, at which point it takes on appearances reminiscent of their eidolon. When your eidolon invests in the egg, it can be hidden inside it instead of unmanifested, and the only activity it can use is to Activate the eidolon egg.

Even though the item is invested by the eidolon, the summoner must have Interacted with the egg in the last minute for the eidolon to Activate it, and the summoner can throw the egg up to 30 feet as part of this Interact. Your eidolon is automatically aware of you using this Interact action and you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2KV87ponbWXgGIhZ]{Act Together} to Interact and Activate the eidolon egg.

Activate Hatch Eidolon 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Requirements The summoner has Interacted with the egg in the last minute

Effect Your eidolon manifests as if you had used Manifest Eidolon using the position of the egg instead of your position for determining the effects.

Duo Defenses.name: Duo Defenses
Duo Defenses.description: You and your eidolon form a walled defense against enemies. As long as you and your eidolon are adjacent to each other, neither of you can become off-guard due to flanking unless both of you are flanked. If you have synergy, you each gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC while adjacent to each other.

Reinforce Eidolon Swap.name: Reinforce Eidolon Swap
Reinforce Eidolon Swap.description: Your summoner gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TYbCj4dgXDOZou9k]{reinforce eidolon} cantrip at level 1 instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HStu2Yhw3iQER9tY]{boost eidolon}. If you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.DxcjEcxTbjlOA2C0]{Reinforce Eidolon} class feat, you gain boost eidolon instead of reinforce eidolon.

Extend Boost Swap.name: Extend Boost Swap
Extend Boost Swap.description: Your summoner gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.CR8OKDbeFJoZbOCu]{extend boost} focus spell at level 1 instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lV8FkHZtzZu7Cy6j]{evolution surge}. If you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.u5cPwhuCd3xTAlWl]{extend boost} class feat, you gain evolution surge instead of extend boost.

Linnorm (Dragon) Eidolon.name: Linnorm (Dragon) Eidolon
Linnorm (Dragon) Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is no mere dragon; it is a mighty linnorm, a ferocious serpent from the north with horrible fangs and a lethal death curse.

Because dragons have a strong connection to magic, their minds can often leave an echo floating in the Astral Plane. Such an entity is extremely powerful but unable to interact with the outside world on its own. Dragon eidolons manifest in the powerful, scaled forms they had in life; most take the form of true dragons (albeit smaller), but some manifest as drakes or other draconic beings. You have forged a connection with such a dragon eidolon and together, you seek to grow as powerful as an ancient wyrm.

Tradition primal

Traits astral, dragon, eidolon, primal, and one more (see Breath Weapon below)

Home Plane The First World

Size Medium

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), horn (piercing), tail (bludgeoning), wing (bludgeoning)

Marauding Dragon Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Cunning Dragon Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 12; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Athletics, Nature

Senses darkvision

Language Draconic

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.I8fG26JJS29ZYwfZ]{breath weapon}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.hGWaUVDJ9A4PLWX3]{death curse}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.P7qw5V2ylPwCWMPB]{wyrm's breath}

Invigorated by Pain.name: Invigorated by Pain
Invigorated by Pain.description: You and your eidolon become invigorated when one of you is harmed. If you or your eidolon is the target of a successful Strike while the other is adjacent or has the creature that made the successful Strike within reach, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.H0W9EDjO1wwp38ty]{Synergy}.

Ancient Surge.name: Ancient Surge
Ancient Surge.description:
You unlock the power of the past, returning your eidolon to a mighty state from the beginning of time. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lV8FkHZtzZu7Cy6j]{evolution surge} you can choose from the following effects:

  • Your eidolon gains tremorsense as an imprecise sense up to 20 feet.
  • Your eidolon gains a resistance to acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage equal to half your level. If your eidolon has a weakness to the selected damage type, you instead reduce the weakness by an equal amount.

Heightened (3rd) Your eidolon gains a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves.

Heightened (5th) Your eidolon treats its degree of success on saves against effects that would give it the grabbed, prone, or restrained conditions as one step better. 

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.3BLKQTWLjbMxY3A9]{Spell Effect: Ancient Surge}

Synthesist Manifestation.name: Synthesist Manifestation
Synthesist Manifestation.description:
Your eidolon is bound to your physical form and can only be manifested to your body. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.s97nKj9Uye1KXr7A]{Meld into Eidolon} class feat. You cannot Manifest your Eidolon normally, but must use Meld into Eidolon. Unlike other summoners who Meld into Eidolon, you can use actions that do not require you to physically move even while you are merged with your eidolon including actions that would require you to speak, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek}, or to Cast a Spell with the concentrate trait that lacks the manipulate trait such as boost eidolon. In addition, you can cast spells while Melded into Eidolon that have the manipulate trait, so long as those spells would only target you or your eidolon and they affect your eidolon instead of you if the spell would normally target you. If a spell or effect would apply an immunity, such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield} cantrip, the immunity applies to both of you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.24bz4IzBHnZomtjE]{Suppress Eidolon} free action.

When you use actions with the tandem trait, you can use actions that meet the requirements specified in your manifestation for Meld into Eidolon when you and your eidolon would use the same action. If a tandem action would require you use the same action, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.qmx8QwVepqI9FqiD]{Tandem Movement}, you can replace the designated action or activity with an action or activity that meets these requirements and takes at most the same number of actions to perform. You can Activate magic items with the consumable trait while your eidolon is manifested, so long as your eidolon has suitable appendages to do so, and you can choose for you or your eidolon to be affected by any consumables you use. If a consumable would be used to Cast a Spell, you must still meet the requirements for the Cast a Spell activity while your eidolon is manifested.

For instance, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2KV87ponbWXgGIhZ]{Act Together} to have your eidolon Strike while you use Recall Knowledge and you could use Tandem Movement to have your eidolon Stride while you attempt to Seek for enemies, but you could not use Act Together to Cast a Spell with the manipulate trait or to perform a Tandem Movement and have your eidolon Stride while you use the Aid action.

In exploration mode, you can perform two exploration activities as normal for a summoner that has their eidolon manifested, but while you are Melded into Eidolon your exploration activity must be actions that meet the same criteria as your manifestation for Meld into Eidolon.

Alternatively, you can choose to share the benefits of either of your activities, each of you gaining the effect of the chosen activity. For instance, you could choose to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OQaFzDtVEOMWizJJ]{Repeat a Spell} of shield, granting your eidolon the effects of your shield while using the exploration activity.

When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3ZzoI9MTtJFd1Kjl]{Share Senses}, your eidolon gains the ability to use skill feats and skill actions to which you have access, as if your eidolon possessed these abilities while merged.

Venomous Secondary Attack.name: Venomous Secondary Attack
Venomous Secondary Attack.description: Your eidolon’s secondary unarmed attack reduces its damage die by 1 step and gains the venomous trait.

Ultimate Form.name: Ultimate Form
Ultimate Form.description:
You unshackle your eidolon and raise its power to near deification. Your eidolon gains a battle form that is Gargantuan (30-foot-by-30-foot space), based on the tradition of magic tied to your eidolon that lasts for 1 minute. You can Dismiss the effect.

Your eidolon gains the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form your eidolon gains:

  • AC = 25 + your level.
  • 30 temporary Hit Points.
  • Darkvision.
  • One or more attacks specific to the battle form chosen, which are the only attacks your eidolon can Strike with. Your eidolon’s attack modifier is +34, and it uses the listed damage. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your eidolon’s unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • Athletics modifier of +36, unless your own is higher.

Your eidolon gains the listed effects for its tradition:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.UQDNIDMzdVkwwrhG]{Arcane Omniscient}
    • Speed 50 feet
    • resistance 5 to magic
    • Melee 1 brush with the arcane (reach 30 feet, agile) Damage 8d4+8 force
    • Ranged 1 arcane bolt (range increment 60 feet, versatile acid, cold, electric, fire, poison, sonic) Damage 6d10+10 force
    • Know All 1 (arcane, fortune) Your eidolon recalls Knowledge on any topic using your Arcana modifier, rolling twice and taking the higher result.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.fghVMCaRPxrTNf1f]{Divine Demiurge}
    • Speed 40 feet, fly 40 feet
    • Melee 1 spiritual blast (reach 30 feet, versatile S) Damage 6d8+12 spirit
    • Ranged 1 planar ray (range increment 100 feet) Damage 6d6+6 spirit
    • Godhood’s Grace (aura, divine) 60 feet. Enemies looking upon your eidolon must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 2} on a critical failure).
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.yt7hz5G86vR2rAKB]{Primal Apex}
    • Speed 40 feet, fly 40 feet
    • Melee 1 wild touch (reach 30 feet) Damage 6d10+10 of the same damage type as your eidolon’s main strike
    • Ranged 1 nature’s voice (range increment 100 feet) Damage 6d8+4 sonic
    • Reshape the Earth 3 Frequency once per minute; Effect Your eidolon’s steps causes forests to grow and mountains to crumble. It creates either a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kOa055FIrO9Smnya]{wall of stone} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.KsWhliKfUs3IpW3c]{wall of thorns} as if it had cast the spell and the spell was heightened to 8th-rank.
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.KWd6yzgaN270nSoh]{Occult Phenomenon}
    • Speed 40 feet
    • resistance 5 to physical damage
    • Melee 1 mind shatter (reach 30 feet) Damage 6d8+4 mental;
    • Ranged 1 agonizing thought (range increment 60 feet) Damage 6d8+4 spirit;
    • World of the Otherworldly (arcane, occult) 60 feet. Strange phenomenons reveal themselves, warping and changing the world around your eidolon. All creatures in the area gain a fly speed of 25 feet, and creatures cannot lower their frightened condition below 1 if they become frightened.

Staff of The Eidolon Binder (Greater).name: Staff of The Eidolon Binder (Greater)
Staff of The Eidolon Binder (Greater).description:
This black staff has white wrappings around its side, marked with otherworldly words of power. It terminates in a large gemstone, which appears to contain entire worlds within it. While wielding a staff of the eidolon binder, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3ZzoI9MTtJFd1Kjl]{Share Senses} as a free action, so long as it is the first action you take for the turn.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.AfOpnnwdZwHi2Tnc]{Protect Companion}
  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}
  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.cwXiKPkZrIupjwlQ]{Summoner's Precaution}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vb2dFNtbofJ7A9BW]{Summoner's Visage}
  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.gWmLT5SkA0qH2mNE]{Envenom Companion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HIY4XUJZKmFLAJTn]{Life Connection}
  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.HqTI6wRrck1YXp3F]{Telepathy}
  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.bay4AfSu2iIozNNW]{Banishment}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.R9xqCBblkS5KE4y7]{Sending}
  • 6th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TFitdEOpQC4SzKQQ]{Runic Weapon}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.

Kaiju Summoner.name: Kaiju Summoner
Kaiju Summoner.description: You are friend and caller to all creatures, even the most mighty of kaiju. Once per day, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.WRP8TDf36hqHyGv1]{summon kaiju} as an innate spell of your eidolon’s tradition.

Elemental Synchronicity.name: Elemental Synchronicity
Elemental Synchronicity.description: You and your eidolon’s attacks are infused with the elements. Choose acid, cold, electricity or fire. When you use Tandem Boost’s synergy combo, you can change the additional damage from precision damage to the damage type you selected and the Strike gains the listed trait. In addition, whenever you or your eidolon critically succeed at a Strike while you have synergy, you deal 3 additional damage of the same type. This additional damage on critical success increases to 6 at 10th level, and to 9 at 18th level.

Aeon Eidolon.name: Aeon Eidolon
Aeon Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is an arbiter of the universe, bound to you to enforce order, whether by its cosmic structure, or simply dutiful management of its natural status. Many aeon eidolons are bound to mortals as a means of keeping track of them, using them for points of data collection, or to prevent them from unraveling the reality. These eidolons are usually obtuse to the mortal emotions, but they form close bonds with summoners over time. Most adhere to duty, fate, knowledge, or time, but other aeon eidolons are known to exist.

Tradition divine

Traits aeon, monitor

Home Plane Axis

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks fist (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

Aeon Enforcer Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +1, Wis +1, Cha –1; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Aeon Adjudicator Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha –1; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Religion, Society

Senses darkvision

Language Utopian

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.j5iyHf7n3wylwfgt]{destined path}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.JZ0TTfEBz6NdeWSA]{traveled path}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.B8lMu6Q79ZpQnPTI]{arbiter of the path}

Bizarre Surge.name: Bizarre Surge
Bizarre Surge.description:
You pull forth secrets of the future to reshape the form of your eidolon, evolving features and structure perfect for the exact issue facing you. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lV8FkHZtzZu7Cy6j]{evolution surge} you can choose from the following effects in addition to the normal effects:

  • Your eidolon gains echolocation, granting it hearing as a precise sense up to 20 feet.
  • Your eidolon gains a resistance to mental damage equal to half your level.

Heightened (3rd) Your eidolon gains a +1 status bonus to Will saves.

Heightened (5th) Your eidolon gains lifesense as an imprecise sense up to 30 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.04ZqXLhTtwsh9jlq]{Spell Effect: Bizarre Surge}

Kindred Warrior Dedication.name: Kindred Warrior Dedication
Kindred Warrior Dedication.description: You and your eidolon have adapted working in tandem to engage foes effortlessly. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.qmx8QwVepqI9FqiD]{Tandem Movement} class feat despite not meeting the prerequisites.

Archon (Angel) Eidolon.name: Archon (Angel) Eidolon
Archon (Angel) Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is one of the original inhabitants of the mountain of Heaven; soldiers of justice with multiple heads, many eyes, and flaming elements.

Your eidolon is a celestial messenger, a member of the angelic host with a unique link to you, allowing them to carry a special message to the mortal world at your side. Most angel eidolons are roughly humanoid in form, with feathered wings, glowing eyes, halos, or similar angelic features. However, some take the form of smaller angelic servitors like the winged helmet cassisian angel instead. The two of you are destined for an important role in the plans of the celestial realms. Though a true angel, your angel eidolon's link to you as a mortal prevents them from casting the angelic messenger ritual, even if they somehow learn it.

Tradition divine

Traits archon, celestial, eidolon

Alignment must be good, usually neutral good

Home Plane Heaven

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks fist (bludgeoning), wing (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

Angelic Avenger Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 8, Wis 12, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Angelic Emissary Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 14; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Intimidation, Religion

Senses darkvision

Language Celestial

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.WyN2qQ2AP4cOMNxF]{hallowed strikes}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.1GrcVMZtL3xAay6x]{be not afraid!}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.Item.BwexjD0jncLH4bY3]{terrifying smite}

Synchronized Counter.name: Synchronized Counter
Synchronized Counter.description:
Trigger You or your eidolon gets a failure on a Strike against a creature.

Requirements You have synergy and both you and your eidolon could make a Strike against the triggering creature.

When one of you is unable to capitalize on an attack, the other makes good on its application. You or your eidolon makes a Strike against the triggering creature using the same multiple attack penalty as the triggering Strike. If your Strike was the triggering action, your eidolon makes this Strike, and if your eidolon’s Strike was the triggering action, you make this Strike.

Dragon Eidolon+.name: Dragon Eidolon+
Dragon Eidolon+.description:
Because dragons have a strong connection to magic, their minds can often leave an echo floating in the Astral Plane. Such an entity is extremely powerful but unable to interact with the outside world on its own. Dragon eidolons manifest in the powerful, scaled forms they had in life; most take the form of true dragons (albeit smaller), but some manifest as drakes or other draconic beings. You have forged a connection with such a dragon eidolon and together, you seek to grow as powerful as an ancient wyrm.

Tradition Choose a tradition associated with your dragon, and you cast spells from the chosen tradition.

Traits astral, dragon, eidolon, the trait associated with your choice of tradition, and one more (see Breath Weapon below)

Home Plane Astral Plane

Size Medium

Suggested Attacks claw (slashing), jaws (piercing), horn (piercing), tail (bludgeoning), wing (bludgeoning)

Marauding Dragon Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 10; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Cunning Dragon Str 12, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 12; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Intimidation, a skill associated with your casting tradition

Senses darkvision

Language Draconic

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.I8fG26JJS29ZYwfZ]{breath weapon}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.oSjJ726kv8wvk1Rb]{draconic frenzy}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.Item.P7qw5V2ylPwCWMPB]{wyrm's breath}

Tandem Casting.name: Tandem Casting
Tandem Casting.description: You and your eidolon coordinate your casting with a united goal in mind. If you or your eidolon’s next action is to Cast a Spell that takes 2 actions or less to cast it gains the tandem trait and the other of the two of you can Cast a Spell that takes the same number of actions or less to cast as part of the same activity. If the spell targets specific creatures, both spells must target at least one creature in common and if the spell has an area of effect the spells must both target either an overlapping area or a creature within the area of effect if the spell would not target an area.

prerequisites.value:
the ability to cast spells from
spell slots

Duo Assault.name: Duo Assault
Duo Assault.description: You and your eidolon coordinate assaults. Enemies are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you and your eidolon when each of you threaten the enemy, regardless of whether you have synergy or not. If you have synergy, when you or your eidolon successfully Strike a creature they are off-guard until the beginning of your next turn.

Genie Eidolon.name: Genie Eidolon
Genie Eidolon.description:
Your eidolon is a genie, serving as an ambassador and sponsor for your pursuits as an adventurer, guiding you to an ultimate purpose that serves you both, often granting the genie the title of shuyookh. Genie eidolons are usually one of the four prominent genies of the elemental planes: Faydhaan, Ifrit, Jaathoom, or Jabali. However, there are rare occurrences of other such types of genies that find they wish to form a bond with a mortal.

Tradition arcane

Traits eidolon, genie

Home Plane elemental plane matching their Genie Incarnation

Size Medium or Small

Suggested Attacks fist (bludgeoning), unarmed attacks shaped like a weapon

Genie Nemesis Str +4, Dex +2, Con +2, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +1; +2 AC (+3 Dex cap)

Genie Courier Str +1, Dex +4, Con +1, Int +0, Wis +1, Cha +2; +1 AC (+4 Dex cap)

Skills Arcana, one skill determined by your Genie Incarnation

Senses darkvision

Language Thalassic (faydhaan), Pyric (ifrit), Sussuran (jaathoom), Petran (jabali), Muan (kizidhar), or Talican (zuhra)

Speed 25 feet

Eidolon Abilities Initial @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.lTnwOn1sqVIKG4Bd]{genie incarnation}; Symbiosis @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.uWDckJaTio7jsmzp]{power of the jinn}; Transcendence @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.misc.QNwQmJ6xABx30vWG]{shuyookh ascendancy}

Symbiotic Evolution.name: Symbiotic Evolution
Symbiotic Evolution.description:
Your connection to your eidolon begins to reflect in your own physiology. You gain one evolution feat your eidolon currently has that is no greater than half your level (minimum 1). You must still meet any prerequisites or requirements for the evolution. For instance, you could take @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-summoners-plus.items.PnVEfLnuSnBKHtGC]{Cryptic Coloration} to develop a camouflage-like skin, but you could not take @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.kFpVgcqREAfDmjXp]{Advanced Weaponry} since you do not possess an eidolon’s primary unarmed attack. You can take these feats as long as the evolution feats don’t require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM.

Special This feat can be taken multiple times, each time gaining a new evolution feat for yourself.

prerequisites.value: At least one feat with the evolution trait

Swarm Body.name: Swarm Body
Swarm Body.description:
Your eidolon is a swarm of creatures that functions as a single creature and it gains the swarm trait. Its size remains the same but it is instead composed of individual creatures that make up that mass and are Tiny. Your eidolon swarm can occupy the same space as other creatures and must do so in order to use its Swarm Attack.

Your eidolon swarm does not have unarmed attacks, but instead gains a Swarm Attack that deals 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, chosen at the time you gain your eidolon. If your eidolon would gain an ability with the eidolon trait that would require it to make a Strike, such as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-Features.ITQghUQFhbYpD2QM]{Beast's Charge}, your eidolon can use its Swarm Attack instead of a Strike. This Swarm Attack applies to all creatures in its space when it takes a single action to do so and has a basic Reflex save equal to 10 + your eidolon’s unarmed attack modifier, including item bonuses from potency runes.

Effects that would normally apply on a successful unarmed Strike from your swarm eidolon apply to creatures that fail their save against your eidolon’s Swarm Attack and effects that would normally apply on a critical hit apply to creatures that critically fail their save.

If your eidolon has a ranged attack, such as from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.oVSlTmdmho8ZQo2k]{Ranged Combatant} feat, your swarm body eidolon can use its Swarm Attack once per turn with the same damage type, damage dice, and range as its ranged unarmed attack against all creatures in a 5-foot square within that range.

Your eidolon swarm is immune to the grabbed, prone, and restrained conditions, has a resistance to precision damage equal to your level, and a weakness to area damage and splash damage equal to your level. Your eidolon doesn’t have a single mind and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area. Since your eidolon does not have an unarmed attack, it cannot provide flanking. 

Special If you take the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.kFpVgcqREAfDmjXp]{Advanced Weaponry} feat, your eidolon’s Swarm Attack also makes targets @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} on a critical failure. If your eidolon gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.0PCDkVnRxVqxsp9j]{Energy Heart} feat, your swarm eidolon’s Swarm Attack changes its damage type to the type you chose. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PM5jvValFkbFH3TV]{Mount} your eidolon as if it were a creature of a size equal to its mass.

Tandem Step.name: Tandem Step
Tandem Step.description: You and your eidolon can move carefully together. You each use a single action to Step.
